document_completeness.summary: All five read FS files contain the full BS, income, OCI, equity and cash-flow statements. Inventory misclassification: bd1e1fbe (complete FY2023 audited FS, 41 pages, all pages textless) is 'scanned_unreadable'; 687abe5c (H1 2026, statements on textless pages 4-8) is 'financial_statements' only via notes pages; 26dbee9b and bef89920 are flagged with income/BS found only from note pages. Text layer of 712f37a5 page 13 (cash flow) is garbled OCR (671,621.123; 162.7 62,985), so a text-layer extractor would produce wrong cash-flow numbers there; image reading was used. PERIOD LABELS: annual FS carry the label of the following year: bef89920 (FY2022) labelled 2023|FY, bd1e1fbe (FY2023) 2024|FY, 26dbee9b (FY2024) 2025|FY, 712f37a5 (FY2025) 2026|FY, so the four annual slots 2023|FY to 2026|FY are each shifted by one year; interim labels (Q1/H1/9M) matched cover text for the files checked (H1 2026 687abe5c 'three and six month periods ended 30 June 2026'; survey covers of 2022 to 2025 interims match). Non-statement files: 2020 and 2021 'financial_statements' f025b3ce and 5f834d2f are 5 to 6 page press releases, 8 one to three page factsheets and about 8 press releases classified inconsistently. Several 2023-2024 interims (cd5991d6, 600c22f8, 796e1dce, dce64048) are labelled 'other_no_statements_found' but are 15 to 17 page interim FS by their covers. No duplicates among statement files.
